purpose: Independently reviewed official officeholder identity and biographical provenance for strictly gated Script 2 House 71–74 cohort
researchMethod: Select at most 8 dated official 89th Texas Legislature bill histories for each of four recorded sponsor roles from the existing KTR database. Bill-role records are not votes or complete legislative counts.

reviews.name: Stan Lambert
verifiedFacts: Official district 71 covers Callahan, Jones, Nolan and Taylor counties
Abilene banker, previously Ennis mayor and Abilene ISD trustee
89th committee chair of Pensions, Investments and Financial Services; Higher Education member

reviews.name: Drew Darby
verifiedFacts: Represents 10 West Texas counties and is from San Angelo
UT Austin BBA and JD; worked in title/real estate business
89th Energy Resources chair; House Administration and State Affairs member

reviews.name: Carrie Isaac
verifiedFacts: District 73 covers Comal and part of Hays County
Prior nonprofit work and Stephen F. Austin bachelor/Purdue University Global master's degrees
89th Elections and Homeland Security, Public Safety and Veterans' Affairs committees
Correct member ID 4265, not House district number 73

reviews.name: Eddie Morales
verifiedFacts: Eleven-county district extends from Maverick County to part of El Paso County
Eagle Pass background, University of Texas at Austin undergraduate degree, St. Mary's law degree
89th Energy Resources vice chair, Governmental Oversight (Select), Transportation member
